subject: Security gates & evidence sprint for BlueFin MAP
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha@bluefinpay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@bluefinpay.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security gates & evidence needs

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. BlueFin is moving this through our payments-platform procurement and we need to lock the MAP security gates so we can hit our Q3 launch. To make scheduling easier, can you confirm Redwood's acceptance criteria for the following items and whether you can provide the artifacts by the dates below?

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest): requested delivery by June 8
- Completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet with answers and evidence links: requested by June 8
- Signed DPA (we've begun redlines): target signature by June 15
- Data retention & deletion controls: confirmation of default retention windows and any customer-configurable options (we need a short write-up and an example retention policy by June 8)
- Audit log access / sampling plan for attestation (how we can verify logs during onboarding): overview by June 8

Can we put these milestones into a short MAP that lists owners and acceptance criteria? If Redwood can commit to delivery dates above, BlueFin will prioritize legal review and hope to sign the PSA/DPA combo by June 15.

A few clarifying Qs for your team:
- For SOC 2, do you provide the full Type II with auditor name and control coverage?
- For SIG, do you prefer to return the CAIQ or a filled-in SIG spreadsheet (we can accept either but BlueFin has an internal SIG tracker)?

Appreciate a quick confirm and a one-pager MAP if possible.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Sr. Security Program Manager
BlueFin Payments

--
Attachment (referenced): bluefin-internal-sig-template.xlsx (we'll upload the tracker once we confirm which format Redwood prefers)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@bluefinpay.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@bluefinpay.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates & evidence needs

Thanks Aisha — this is exactly the level of detail we want in the MAP. Short answer: yes, we can commit to the June 8/June 15 runway with a couple of clarifications below. I'll own the MAP and track artifacts; looping legal and SEs for the specifics.

High-level acceptance criteria we propose (draft MAP):
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood will provide the most recent auditor-issued SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability controls (PDF + auditor name). Acceptance = receipt of report and ability to verify scope matches BlueFin's production tenancy.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will return a completed CAIQ-style spreadsheet with evidence links. Acceptance = completed spreadsheet + at least one evidence artifact per high-risk control (e.g., config screenshot, policy, log sample).
- DPA: Redwood Legal will provide an executed DPA or redline responses. Acceptance = DPA countersigned by both parties.
- Data retention: Redwood will provide a one-page retention summary plus an example retention config (S3 lifecycle/DB TTL example) showing default 30-day token retention and options for 90/365 day retention for enterprise plans. Acceptance = written confirmation + sample config.
- Audit logs: Redwood will provide an export sample and a runbook describing how customers request log snapshots during onboarding. Acceptance = delivery of sample logs + runbook.

We'll attach a MAP spreadsheet with owners and dates (first tab = milestones). Marcus Lin (SE, cc'd) will gather the technical evidence pointers; Laura Bennett (cc'd) will shepherd the DPA/contract items.

Attachments I'll send now: Redwood MAP skeleton (attached) and our last SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — you'll see the auditor and coverage.

I'll follow up with a one-page MAP by end of day.

– Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood-map-evidence-sprint-2027-05-28.xlsx; redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@bluefinpay.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates & evidence needs

Aisha — looping in legal comments so BlueFin has visibility into the DPA timeline. A few items from legal: 

- DPA redlines: please send your redline PDF or DocuSign-trackable redlines. We'll aim to turn our comments within 3 business days of receiving them.
- Data retention windows: Redwood's default for hosted API tokens is 30 days; for Dedicated/Private customers we offer configurable retention and can support 90/365 day windows on enterprise contracts. Laura can provide clause language for insertion into the DPA; acceptance = clause language + customer confirmation of selection at order.
- Subprocessor list: we'll provide our current subprocessor registry (SaaS infra + telemetry vendors). Acceptance = registry link + date-stamped snapshot.

Marcus — can you confirm the format of the audit-log sample we'll provide? Ideally we give a sanitized CSV with a 7-day sample and a short runbook describing fields and access controls.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment stub referenced: redwood-dpa-template-v3.docx

From: Aisha Malik <aisha@bluefinpay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@bluefinpay.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates & evidence needs

Logan/Laura/Marcus — thanks all, that aligns with BlueFin's expectations. Confirming next steps and owners so I can update our procurement MAP: 

- By June 8: Redwood to deliver SOC 2 Type II (PDF), completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet (with evidence links), one-page data retention summary + sample config, and sanitized 7-day audit log CSV + runbook. Owner: Logan (coord) / Marcus (evidence).
- By June 9: BlueFin to complete internal security review and surface any follow-ups. Owner: Aisha (coord).
- By June 15: Target for PSA + DPA signature (subject to legal redline turnaround). Owner: Laura (Redwood legal) + BlueFin legal.

Please also attach the SOC report and the MAP spreadsheet to the HubSpot deal record so our procurement system has them. Once we have the listed artifacts we'll treat technical review as cleared and move to final contracting.

If anything slips on your side, flag early — we can shift signature to June 22 but would prefer the June 15 target to keep our integration window.

I'll wait for the MAP file and the SOC/PDF upload.

Best,
Aisha
Sr. Security Program Manager
BlueFin Payments
